g.text: every change is recorded; /undo reverts a turn
Kubic runs in-process with your authority: no isolation (files, network,
e.g. "run npm test and fix the failing test"
make slugify handle accents, then run the tests

type to queue — sent when this turn ends
Accented letters fall through the replace. I'll split them into letter and mark, then drop the
slugify now strips accents: it splits each letter from its mark and drops the marks before the
rest is replaced. Both tests pass.
